title: thoughtful review
excerpt: Here is one of the most thoughtful reviews I’ve seen of Finding Our Way Again … I love the way the reviewer makes connections with other writers, from Walter Brueggemann to Henri Nouwen to Jim Wallis to Bernard of Clairvaux, etc.
